 The recently discussed Kulsai Hydroelectric Project is located on the border of Assam and Meghalaya.

The primary objective of the Bhagini Nivedita Scheme launched by the West Bengal government is to provide financial assistance to unmarried women pursuing higher education.

11. हाल ही में भौगोलिक संकेत (GI Tag) प्राप्त करने वाला प्रसिद्ध मंदिर प्रसाद 'अंबाजी मोहनथाल' गुजरात राज्य से संबंधित है। 
The famous temple prasad 'Ambaji Mohanthal', which recently received the Geographical Indication (GI Tag), belongs to Gujarat.

Nameri Tiger Reserve was recently granted 'CA|TS Approved' (Conservation Assured | Tiger Standards) status for meeting global standards in wildlife conservation and tiger habitat management.

The Living Planet Report is published biennially by the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF).
